descriptions.notStarted: I have decided to become one of the Knights serving the young Empress and battle the indestructible Black Mage. I better first meet up with #b#p1101000# and formally introduce myself.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1101000# expressed her gratitude on my decision to become a Cygnus Knight and made a promise that she will always be there for me.
descriptions.completed: #p1101000# claims that it is ultimately in my hands in terms of defeating the Black Mage. She says that her trustworthy Tactician, #p1101002#, will be responsible for molding me into a formidable Knight.
